title: Hindustan Unilever, PB Fintech among 7 stocks that hit 52-week lows and slipped up to 47% in a month - Fresh Lows | The Economic Times
text:
On Wednesday, the benchmark Sensex fell 49 points to close at 72,480. Amid the market decline, eight stocks from the BSE 100 Index touched fresh 52-week lows, hitting their lowest price levels in the past year. A 52-week low refers to the lowest price at which a stock has traded over the past year and is commonly used as an indicator of its recent price performance.

New 52-week low: Rs 945| CMP: Rs 980. In the last one month, the stock has fallen about -47%.
